summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K reporting daily purchases under its previously announced share buyback programmes. From 14-18 September 2026, the company repurchased 3,549,291 ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange via JP Morgan Securities plc at a volume-weighted average price of roughly 978.9 pence per share. The repurchased shares will be cancelled, reducing shares in issue to 2,485,775,004. Since programme inception, 68,171,965 shares have been bought back at a VWAP of 1,071.3620p. Watch execution pace and cancellation impact on EPS accretion and overhang.
